title: Crawl
description: What happens to the pages and files: page elements removed before the Markdown is made (Firecrawl excludeTags), and whether the document files are converted by the file converter connection.

excludedTags.title: Excluded tags
excludedTags.description: Comma separated tag names, e.g. nav, form, footer, aside.

waitFor.title: Wait before scraping (ms)
waitFor.description: Optional. Milliseconds Firecrawl waits after the page loaded, for content that scripts or web components load later. Slows every page.

convertFiles.title: Convert files
convertFiles.description: Download the files that discover lists and convert them to Markdown.

pdfPageMarkers.title: PDF page markers
pdfPageMarkers.description: A <!--page:N--> line before each PDF page, so sources can link to the page.

ocr.title: OCR scanned PDFs
ocr.description: Pages of a PDF without a text layer (scans) are read by OCR. About 5 seconds per scanned page.

converters.title: Conversion tool per extension
converters.description: Optional. Default markitdown, csv: pandas, xlsx: xlsx-formulas.
